column1: Indicator: Local Currency Debt Securities Outstanding (amount)
Definition: This indicator shows the absolute amount of outstanding local currency (LCY) debt securities
column5: or corporate. Sovereign debt securities include Treasury bills and Treasury bonds; other government debt securities comprise issuances by some public institutions with government guarantees
column6: including local governments and some government-owned entities. Corporate debt securities include issuances of private sector companies and other public sector institutions.
